name: Hope Coin
description: Hope Coin (HOP) is a fixed-cap ERC-20 token on Ethereum. Maximum supply is hard-capped on-chain at 250,000,000 HOP. A single flat 2% transfer fee accrues to a fixed treasury address and cannot be changed by anyone; there are no other fees, no blocklists, and no pausing.
notes: Official site: hopecoin.com, the coin's only web property (cp17.org forwards there; hopecoin.org belongs to someone else and is never ours). By decision the coin and the book are tied: direct purchases of The Cardinal's Promise include a fixed number of HOP, claimable via the site, from a published program wallet. Fill in contract addresses after deployment before submitting to Etherscan token update, CoinGecko, or a Uniswap token list. Etherscan requires a 32x32 PNG icon — use assets/logo-32.png.
